transcript.message: Yeah, this is Marcus. Who's this?

Marcus, Dren from Outsorcy. Cold call. You've got two SDR reqs open at seventy to eighty OTE and I place full-time SDRs who work only for you from our office. Thirty seconds to say why this isn't the agency thing most VPs in cyber have been burned by?
We did the outsourced SDR thing last year. It was a disaster. Why would this be different?
Tell me what broke first, the reps, the messaging or the management?
All of it. Three 'dedicated' reps who turned out shared. Fourteen meetings in four months, three qualified. Messaging drifted off the CISO persona in a month and nobody over there was managing them.

Shared reps, drift, nobody on the floor. That's the agency model and it fails the same way every time. Here's the difference, concretely: you interview and pick one person, they're our full-time employee, they work only Northwind's book, nine to five Eastern, on your tools and your messaging, from our office in Pristina where a manager reviews their calls every day. No shared seats. We don't write your messaging and we don't sell meetings.
Okay, keep going. What happens when the guy's bad? Because he will be.
Then the billing clock stops and we replace him in about a week. What we won't do is pay per meeting; that's the incentive that got you shared reps.
My buyers are CISOs. The second they hear a call-centre accent they hang up.

Which is why you hear them before anyone starts. Five-question video interviews on every profile, then a live interview with you. If they can't hold a conversation with you, they never get near a CISO. Have you sold into security with offshore reps before, or is this the first time?
First time. Name one security company you've done this for.

Most of our named references are healthtech, like a client that booked about two hundred and fifty qualified meetings in a quarter against a plan of a hundred. For security specifically, I'd rather Travis, our AE, show you the accounts than have me name-drop. Twenty minutes with him Thursday at two or Friday at ten?
Friday at ten. And I want profiles of people who've sold to technical buyers, not generic.
Friday at ten Eastern with Travis, and I'll have two or three profiles of reps with technical-buyer experience in your inbox before then. Best email?
m reyes at northwindsecurity dot com.
Got it. Friday at ten, Marcus.
